{
  "name": "rjmlaird-tools",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@9.15.0",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "pnpm -r --parallel dev",
    "build": "pnpm gen && pnpm export:builds && pnpm -r build",
    "typecheck": "pnpm -r typecheck",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "gen": "pnpm --filter @rjmlaird/ui gen",
    "export:builds": "tsx scripts/export-builds.ts",
    "check:builds-export": "tsx scripts/export-builds.ts --check",
    "test": "pnpm -r --if-present test",
    "deploy:all": "pnpm -r --if-present run deploy"
  },
  "prettier": "@rjmlaird/prettier-config",
  "devDependencies": {
    "@rjmlaird/eslint-config": "workspace:*",
    "@rjmlaird/prettier-config": "workspace:*",
    "eslint": "^9.14.0",
    "prettier": "^3.3.3",
    "tsx": "^4.19.0",
    "typescript": "^5.6.3",
    "wrangler": "^4.0.0"
  }
}
